name: card-clash

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @card-clash/server" "npm run dev -w @card-clash/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @card-clash/engine && npm run build -w @card-clash/server && npm run build -w @card-clash/client

author: Danilo Lima
description: An attributes comparison card game about pirates
